test_ml_backend_set_for_prelabeling: test the ML backend API to set a model version for prelabeling on a project
test_ml_backend_not_set_for_prelabeling: test that ML backend is not set for prelabeling when a model version is already assigned
test_model_version_on_save: test that the project model version updates when an ML backend title is changed
test_model_version_on_delete: test that the project model version resets when an ML backend is deleted
test_security_write_only_payload: test that ML backend password fields are write-only and never returned in API responses
